# Vendor logos

Logos and trademarks belong to their owners and are used nominatively to identify the bookmaker, exchange or platform a pick or integration refers to. They are served from this folder and never hotlinked.

Every SVG was parsed and sanitized (scripts, foreignObject, images, event handlers and external references removed) and given a square viewBox. PNGs are stripped of metadata and capped at 256px.

## Monogram fallback

No acceptable logo was found for these registry entries (vendor sites refuse automated requests, no official app icon or Commons file), so they keep the monogram badge:

- betonlineag (BetOnline)
- lowvig (LowVig)
- pinnacle (Pinnacle)
- betmma (betmma.tips)
